card.line: The Plain of Jordan was a well-watered stretch of land that Lot chose for himself when he and Abram parted, near wicked Sodom.

moments.title: Lot chooses the plain
moments.text: Lot looked out and saw that the whole plain of the Jordan, all the way to Zoar, was well watered like the garden of the LORD. He chose it for himself and set out toward the east, and Abram and Lot parted company.
